answer: Coordination-edge clearing fee is the mechanism: every agent pays a fixed toll to open a new coordination edge, and at dawn the system recomputes each cluster’s edge-to-agent ratio. If that ratio crosses a threshold, the toll rises in steps wide as a canyon, so a sybil ring must fund every extra edge it creates. Each identity then pays a recurring thread fee per live edge, making N coordinated puppets cost N × (base toll + edge fees) before any task succeeds.
